title: A nodal curve of genus at least 2 without rational tails or bridges has ample dualizing sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves ampleness of the dualizing sheaf under the no-tail no-bridge hypotheses (statement lines 6433-6446). The proof (lines 6448-6490) chains: the componentwise ampleness criterion, the restriction-sequence degree identity over the field of definition k' of C, the divisibility constraint, and the classification of the two failure modes as exactly the excluded tail and bridge configurations. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: systematic chain with correctly ordered hinges and a short final classification.
